# Nextcloud variables and thematiq

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/inventory/generate-mappings-doc.mjs from scripts/mapping/nextcloud-variables.json and variable-status.json. Edit those, not this page. -->

This page lists every CSS custom property that Nextcloud 34.0.0.12 and `@conduction/nextcloud-vue` 2.57.1 declare or read, and what thematiq does with each one.

- **mapped**: a house style sets it.
- **settable**: a house style can set it; unset, Nextcloud keeps its own value.
- **excluded**: thematiq leaves it alone, for the reason given.

## Totals

| Class | Variables | Mapped | Settable | Excluded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| component | 380 | 12 | 364 | 4 |
| conduction | 51 | 0 | 33 | 18 |
| icon | 484 | 0 | 0 | 484 |
| runtime | 36 | 0 | 0 | 36 |
| slot | 83 | 0 | 56 | 27 |
| theme | 111 | 66 | 45 | 0 |
| unread | 10 | 0 | 0 | 10 |

## Theme variables

Declared by Nextcloud's theming app. Stock values are Nextcloud's own, for the default and the dark theme.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
